title: Interaction
summary: Micro-interactions on everyday controls: send buttons, toggles, dials, meters.
description: Ordinary controls with one considered motion each. The effect switches on for the state that matters and stays out of the way for the rest.

title: Pixel Lab
summary: Components that live in a pixel lattice: meters, gauges, orbs, radars, AI moments.
description: The visual is the data. Meters, gauges, clocks and model moments drawn on a 4 px lattice, with shine near the active edge.

title: Pixel UI
summary: Form controls you can ship, each with one pixel detail.
description: Text fields, selects, date pickers, toasts, tabs and charts as React components on your Tailwind theme. They submit with native forms and are keyboard complete, with a single pixel detail each.

title: Pixel HD
summary: Regular controls on a high-fidelity dot field with bloom and ordered dither.
description: A fine dot grid with bloom and ordered dither behind regular controls. Numerals and labels are real text; the field reacts around them.

title: Location
summary: Globes, maps and connection lines for locations, visitors, sign-ins, latency and traffic between regions.
description: Where things happen and how they connect: dot globes, partial globes and flat maps drawn from an embedded world dataset, with no map tiles. The dots carry the motion; every label and number stays real text.
